_comment: Video registry rendered by watch.html. Every video on this site is a real screen recording of the live site with a human voice — no generated footage, no stock music, and captions always (scripts/check-videos.mjs refuses to publish an entry without an on-disk WEBVTT file). To publish: record per the entry's scriptPath, encode H.264/AAC at ~1280x800 (<= ~25 MB per clip), commit the mp4 + .vtt captions + poster jpg under assets/video/, set status to 'published', run node scripts/check-videos.mjs. status is 'planned' or 'published'.

videos.title: How to trust this site — in 90 seconds
videos.summary: One box that routes any question to the right tool, and a verification badge on every claim: what ● Verified, ○ Pending, and ~ Nuanced mean, and how to click through to the primary source yourself.

videos.title: Find your theme — from a life question to the text
videos.summary: Pick forgiveness, marriage, trade, or peace: each theme maps to its root families and the computed passages where that vocabulary clusters — an honest lexical starting point for your own reading.

videos.title: Train your eye — the exercises
videos.summary: Commit before you check: spot the recurring roots yourself, then reveal the computed answer; outline a surah's discourse yourself, then compare it with the outline in Dr. Khan's published book.

videos.title: Browse by juz
videos.summary: The Qur'an's standard 30-part reading division, one click from the navigate page to the first verse of any juz.

videos.title: Pin a verse or root to your workspace
videos.summary: Pin verses and roots you want to return to — a client-only bookmark list, saved to your browser, never sent anywhere.

videos.title: Does a root's company change over 23 years?
videos.summary: Mercy and forgiveness are each other's closest companion in the text — broken out by the traditional revelation periods, the pairing strengthens from Middle Meccan to Medinan.
